item.title: RimWorld Pawn Planner — Build Your Starting Colonists
item.description: Use the RimWorld pawn planner to design your starting colonists. Set skill levels, pick up to two traits, and see your build instantly — built for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version. item.title: RimWorld Skills List — All Skills Explained (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: RimWorld colonists have 12 skills. Each affects how fast and how well they perform a type of work. This guide explains each skill for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version. All RimWorld Skills SkillWhat it does ShootingRanged weapon accuracy. MeleeClose combat and melee weapon crafting. ConstructionBuilding speed and quality. MiningRock mining and digging speed. CookingMeal prep speed and food-poisoning avoidance. PlantsGrowing, sowing and harvesting crops. AnimalsTaming and handling animals. CraftingQuality of crafted weapons, armor and apparel.
